patterns.what_worked: The cross-lane enable contract is now a single delegation point: weave_range.lua's wr.class_default_on(ST) calls ST.weave_range_default_enabled(ST.player_class) (config_presets.lua:1599-1604), and wr.enabled_for stays pure on the resolved boolean. The options getter (option_tables.lua:195-224) falls back to the same reader, so a fresh profile, a pre-key nil profile, the settings UI and the runtime gate cannot disagree.
patterns.what_was_hard: Nothing structural: the only trap was the helper's dot-style definition (no self), which the first test stub called colon-style and briefly broke 25 pins in the new suite; the stub now matches the shipped call shape.
patterns.what_is_filed: Bench report Sec.5.1 row and Sec.8 mutations M8/M9 updated; no other lane owes anything for this contract. The options desc replacement from Sec.6 is still owed by appearance-options (it still promises a band fallback), and that is the only open cross-lane item.
